title: Agent Evidence Lab experiment run — v0.1
description: Run/experiment-arm lineage, kept OUTSIDE agent_event.schema.json by design (added on review — the original event schema had no way to join events to a treatment arm). One of these per session; every event in that session carries this run's run_id as a foreign key.

run_kind.description: Gates publication: the export validator MUST refuse to export any run whose run_kind is not controlled_public_benchmark, regardless of any other field.

policy_id.description: null for condition == baseline. Identifies the intervention under test.

model.description: The model selected BEFORE launch, recorded in this manifest at run setup — not harvested from agent-turn evidence after the fact. Two rules, both fixture-derived: (1) Claude Code emits a literal '<synthetic>' model value on locally-generated lines (title generation and similar UI bookkeeping); '<synthetic>' MUST NEVER populate this field. (2) If agent-turn evidence shows a different model than recorded here, or shows a mid-run model switch, the run is marked disposition 'scope_confounded' — never silently treated as a single-model run.

model_source.description: How `model` was established. REQUIRED non-null whenever model is non-null. 'declared_preflight': recorded in this manifest at run setup, before launch — the only form permitted for run_kind 'controlled_public_benchmark' (enforced below). 'observed_from_trace': harvested from agent-turn evidence, which is the only thing available when ingesting an already-completed dogfood session that never had a pre-launch manifest. Without this discriminator, dogfood ingestion would have to either discard a verified-observed fact or silently violate the pre-launch rule.

model_evidence_consistent.description: Whether observed agent-turn model values across the run matched this manifest's declared model. Null = not yet checked. False REQUIRES disposition 'scope_confounded' (enforced below). Verified constant within each of the 3 sessions hand-checked during schema development, but n=3 is not a guarantee — the check is per-run, not assumed.

model_configuration.description: Free-form key/value of relevant non-secret run configuration (e.g. temperature, extended-thinking on/off). Never credentials or API keys.

task_id.description: Identifies the frozen task/prompt set this run executed — required so a pair can be verified scope-comparable.

pinned_commit.description: The exact commit the run started from.

eligibility.description: Frozen in advance, before either arm runs — records whether this run's task actually presented a comparable opportunity for the pattern under test, independent of whether the policy fired.

disposition.description: Every run gets one of these, including calibration and discarded runs — none are silently dropped from the local record. Only completed_analyzable runs enter a compliance comparison. 'scope_confounded': the run executed but something makes it non-comparable to its pair — currently, model evidence disagreeing with the declared model, or a mid-run model switch. Distinct from 'excluded' (a deliberate exclusion decision) and 'discarded' (the run did not usefully complete): scope_confounded says the run happened and is being kept in the record precisely so the confound is visible.

disposition_reason.description: Required in practice (not schema-enforced as required, to avoid blocking capture) whenever disposition != completed_analyzable.

allOf.$comment: baseline runs must not carry a policy identity — was only prose before.
intervention runs must name the policy under test, non-null and non-empty.
a run whose observed model evidence contradicts its declared model cannot be dispositioned as analyzable. Enforced, not left to operator discipline.
a model value with no stated provenance is exactly the ambiguity model_source exists to remove.

public-benchmark evidence must name its model before launch. Harvesting it from the trace after the fact is permitted only for dogfood/calibration ingestion, never for a run that can become public evidence.
